prompt: From the hard shoulder of a jammed motorway at night, looking up as an enormous steel container crane strides over the carriageway: one jointed leg planted on each side of the road, a third leg swinging forward above the traffic, dust and sparks falling from its knee, cars below lit by its floodlights, people ducking between them.
